findings.film: ସୁନା ସଂସାର | Suna Sansara / Suna Sansar

evidence.type: Previously inspected public reproduction of an attributed director's account
evidence.summary: Deo attributes the account to Sisir Mishra in Banichitra, New Year 1978, edited by Parikshit Jena. It describes pooled funds, bank borrowing, Manmath Nath Das's story and a working title Paribar.
evidence.limits: Original magazine not obtained. Do not present finance as independently verified, claim Paribar was a published novel, or assert all film copies are lost.

evidence.summary: Encyclopedia of Indian Cinema lists Suna Sansar, Sisir Mishra, Odia, 1978. Its Mishra profile also lists the film under 1978.
evidence.limits: Search-indexed text inspected; full PDF exceeds web fetch limit. Exact theatrical date not established.

evidence.type: Retrospective film database; direct page inspected
evidence.summary: Credits Dr Manmathnath Das for story, Sisir Mishra for direction/screenplay, Panchajanya Productions, and reports 13 January 1978 at Prabhat and Jyoti Talkies. Cites Bhim Singh's Odia Chalachitra Ra Agyat Adhyaya and Odiamelody.
evidence.limits: Underlying book pages and original credits not inspected. Corroborative lead, not independent primary verification. Other databases disagree about year/date.
Do not adopt this precise date. Record unresolved conflict; 1978 has stronger scholarly support.

evidence.type: Commercial music catalogue; direct listing inspected
evidence.summary: Suna Sansar Original Motion Picture Soundtrack lists five tracks and a 2024 Saregama rights notice. Track titles include Raja Mora Raja, He Dukha Hari, Michha Maya Bhara, Mu Hajichhi Tumari Sapanl and Arey Dhara Re.
evidence.limits: Displayed 31 December 1978 is album metadata, not proven film release date. Artist rows mix contributors without specifying roles. Playback, territory and full-film availability not tested.

findings.recommendation: Best suited to a carefully attributed case study inside cinema economics and literature-to-screen work. A soundtrack listing provides a separate listening lead; it does not establish survival or loss of the film.

sources.author: Jyoti Prakash Sahoo
sources.summary: Sisir Mishra recalled screenplay and dialogue discussions at his Jhanjiri Mangala home, with Hara Patnaik introduced by assistants Srikant Choudhury and Jyoti Nayak. He remembered their morning bicycle visits. The introduction credits wife Kadambini as writer/co-writer; a question identifies her Odia story behind Bheegi Palkein. His response recalls her Sambalpuri saris used in the film.
sources.limits: Use as attributed recollection. The article contains apparent attribution/chronology problems elsewhere, including associating Jyoti Swarup with Mother India; do not import its whole biography. Kadambini story authorship is in interviewer framing; original film credits/source text still needed. Proposed Konark film, budget and cast are 2018 plans, not completed outcomes.

sources.author: Jyoti Prakash Sahoo
sources.type: Separate published participant interview; direct text inspected
sources.summary: Himanshu 'Chandi' Parija recalled theatre work with Samuel Sahu and Hara Patnaik introducing him to Sisir Mishra for assistant-director work on Ae Ama Sansara in 1985. He credited his wife, actor Sadhana Parija (Runu), with support and help during Suna Harini's story development.
sources.limits: Specific recollections, not audited work records or proof of a formal writing credit. Do not adopt broad criticism of younger workers, unverified allegations or causal claims about audience decline.

findings.recommendation: Develop an article about learning filmmaking through theatre, assistants, writing rooms and mentorship. Connect it to the future chapter's practical proposal for paid apprenticeships; label that proposal as ours, not a historical conclusion.

sources.summary: Names Banichitra editor Parikshita Jena and describes its annual event recognising film/theatre workers. Confirms the magazine/editor connection.
sources.limits: URL dated May 2011, displayed archive update May 2012. Does not verify the 1978 issue or settle magazine founding date.

sources.summary: Searched visible index for Banichitra; no matching listing found in this index.
sources.limits: Non-discovery is not proof of absent holdings elsewhere or an undigitised original. Canonical odiabibhaba URL could not be fetched through web tool.

findings.recommendation: Expand Reading Odia Cinema to recognise magazines, editors and film booklets as evidence alongside books; verify particular issues before treating reproduced text as an inspected original.

findings.summary: Anvesha checked song identities and the 2016 Prasar Bharati archival release. Same-title recordings and contributor-role ambiguities prevent automatic credit assignment.
findings.recommendation: AIR Cuttack can gain a concrete archival-release example. A wider song article needs original recording credits; no linear folk-to-radio-to-cinema genealogy has been established.

attempts_for_original_banichitra: Targeted English and Odia searches for 1978 New Year issue and Suna Sansara account; no original issue retrieved.
Srujanika/Odia Bibhaba magazine index inspected; no Banichitra title found in the visible index.
Odia Virtual Academy domain-specific search and broader library/magazine searches; no accessible matching issue located.

next_actions.item: Develop mentorship / apprenticeship article outline from two separate participant interviews in the same outlet by the same interviewer; verify credited film work and seek additional women and technicians' own accounts.
Locate Banichitra New Year 1978 issue or Bhim Singh's cited pages before a full Suna Sansara finance/adaptation narrative. No repeated identical searches; next step is an identifiable new collection.
Inspect Bheegi Palkein original credits and Kadambini's source text before a dedicated literature-crossing-languages case study.
Verify original song sleeves/credits and Prasar Bharati CD booklet. Keep music versions, rights and release dates distinct.

rights: No photographs, scans or recordings copied to public assets; catalogue access does not establish a reuse licence.

review.status: Qualified pass by Drishti after reading both research records
review.findings: Use two separate participant interviews, not independent corroboration. Kadambini's story authorship is interviewer framing; Sadhana's creative help is her husband's recollection. Neither yet establishes a formal screenwriting credit. Keep Suna Sansara finances attributed pending original magazine; music identity limitations retained.
